steps.heading: Everything waiting on you
steps.text: Open ask-user todos that block the planner, proposed hypotheses ready for a look, and papers flagged for triage — one queue for the things only a person can unstick.

steps.heading: Alerts
steps.text: System-level warnings, not workflow — the badge tells you something needs attention before it becomes a bigger problem.

steps.heading: Gripes
steps.text: This is where you file bugs. Anything wrong with the app, the data, or a workflow — write it down here and it becomes trackable, not lost in a chat scrollback.
